issues.description: Constructor parameter type for Bookstore is inconsistent: the problem statement requires init(books: [Book]) (an array of Book) but the solution implements init(books: Set<Book>) (a Set). This mismatch also conflicts with how the solution's Client constructs and passes a [Book] when calling Bookstore(books: books). Students following the problem statement or the template will expect an initializer taking [Book], so the Set parameter in the solution is a structural inconsistency that would prevent the example solution from compiling and confuse students about the intended API.
issues.suggested_fix: Make the Bookstore initializer accept an array as specified in the problem: change the initializer in Bookstore to init(books: [Book]) { self.books = books }. This aligns the API with the problem statement and the way the Client assembles and passes a [Book].
